name: Mini Shooters
author: Addicting Games
description: Mini Shooters is a free IOgame. Cute shooter games are one of the most popular game types online. Cute shooter games are all about surviving on the battlefield and fighting the enemy. Cute shooter games have become a major hit with players of all ages. With cute shooter games like Mini-Shooters, you can customize your own individual little character, from the weapons, and equipment to the way they look. All of the choices you make in your customizations will inevitably help you fight against enemies. You can also team up with other players online from around the world in order to complete missions and cream other teams. Cute shooter games are an excellent way to spend time with your online friends while sharpening your point-and-click skills like the true bad apple you really are. don't just pretend to be cool, with Mini Shooters you can actually be cool. We suggest it, we encourage it. This game will allow you to collect items as well as customize your character in almost any way you want. Nothing is not safe for work of course but it's all safe for fun.
